reviewCorrections: Completed census cannot erase a failed operation or exceed high-water output limits.
Worker stopped report also requires a successful unforced worker exit.
All channel setup resources are closed on failure; post-spawn and finalization failures preserve owned cleanup.
Transient supervision error keeps the failure but permits bounded recovery ticks on a still-held lease.
Failed report backlog cannot suppress polling and unaccounted worker cleanup emits only one KILL escalation.
Combined diagnostic accounting includes parsed groups, raw worker/probe streams and duplicated exposed worker receipt; cap failures preserve failure/pending/cleanup and deny retention.
